title: Implement encoded physical Compact operations through B1
body:
I implement PR2250's complete dirty compact operation with encoded Count controls, fixed physical tape roles and the actual B1 binary backend from PR2899. I include both source orders, constant toggles, raw rotations, exceptional-record sorting/reinsertion and the highest selected-bit operation. I preserve borrowed inputs and descriptors, restore dirty fields, and return arbitrary positive outer rows in order.

Under the pinned ordinary-callee arguments, I obtain the retained compact bound `O(V*(1+((f-1)*G)^tau))` in the long-record domain, with `tau=99830289/100000000`. PROOF.md charges the per-row binary calls, encoded arithmetic, keys, copies and disposal before absorption. I separate blank work at return from backing arrays retained after larger prior calls. I claim no new compact identity or selected exponent.

I passed all eight registered cold commands on Python 3.12.15/macOS arm64: 151 control states and 904 offsets; complete early/late/toggle rectangles; two complete 4,096-record two-digit cases; an 8,192-record mixed-guard case; a 1,024-column fitted binary handoff; and semantic/source/ownership rejection controls. Payload checks track every input bit, disable the indexed reference oracle during execution, and check borrowed state and workspace erasure. The arithmetic and rejection suites also pass with assertions disabled.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/physical-complex-compact
```

I verified all 36 package/input files against commit `9dc841c9a101435fdd15e0f7623bf16b6d0363e9`. Canonical main remains `d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641`; I refreshed it at 20:52 UTC and checked new overlap at 20:53. Hosted CI remains unverified.

The small complete Compact cases use B1's elementary branch; the separate handoff forces a declared reduced fitted body. I retain the written universal predecessor arguments and have not executed the selected GL64/O(73,2) payload or a formal refinement. Gaussian phase traversal, the full recursive complex caller and analytic transfer remain separate. B1's coarse rate suffices for selected #1094, but I do not transfer it to PR2979's higher candidate claim.

I coordinate in [Discussion2238](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2238#discussioncomment-18971213). I retain Douglas Colkitt's compact construction, PR2250's guard lineage, the full ordinary/BIT source attribution, ywz65's PR2534 child/row fixture, the formal phase results and the existing repair audits. Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including analysis subagents. I preserve both source archives and their notices.
